Here at Romford and Ilford Family Chiropractic we offer a unique chiropractic service to people from all walks of life, from professional athletes to newborns, in the East London, Havering and Essex area. Our aim is to exceed your expectations as primary health care providers by empowering you to reach and maintain your optimum state of health.
We honour life, health and the healing process, and we treat each person that walks through our door how you would like to be treated - with love, compassion, understanding and truth. We are continually growing, learning and refining our skills so that we are able to give you the best service possible regarding your most precious resource - your health.
 
Along with providing the highest quality chiropractic care, our goal is to provide you with the education and inspiration you need to help you make positive lifestyle changes and choices so you can experience optimal health, happiness and well-being, and be in charge of fulfilling your own go
